items.text: Survey host signup/application pages, earnings page and public settings API (found: schema, migration and env config for all three features already exist; the service logic and the public fee endpoint did not)
Build the fee comparison calculator on the become-a-host page (public /api/public/fees + page, verified against the live schedule)
Add founding-host perk (capped lower commission for early hosts)
Add referral reward for hosts who bring in new hosts
Add sign-up nudges for hosts who abandon their application
Verify with lint, build and server tests, then commit and push
